title: At-Takathur 102:5-8 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: At-Takathur, Al-Qari'ah, madd letters and shaddah
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 31 (Pupil PDF worksheet: At-Takathur 102:5-8 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 31. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ (٥) لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ (٦) ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ (٧) ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ (٨)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
You will surely see the Hellfire.
Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.

questions.q: Chunk and link At-Takathur 102:5-8 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 102:5-8 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Draw three blessings (food, water, home) on the pupil PDF, no people.

questions.a: A) the blessings we were given. 102:8: 'Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.'

questions.q: Think again: 102:8 says we will be asked about the good things (na'im) we were given. What good things has Allah given you today?
questions.a: Food, water, a home, family, eyes, health: we say alhamdulillah and use them well.
